Define finite adjunctions, counit-normalized identifications, the invertible evaluation-extension comparison whose transpose is the identity, evaluated Brown-right-adjoint comparisons preserving counits, quotient projection mates, and actual transition, identity and composition equations. Quotient mates are maps; no global mate invertibility is asserted.
